methodology: Read source files once at the pinned commit; no media or remote library files were downloaded.
Collect HTML resource attributes, srcset candidates, data JSON, CSS url/import references and file-shaped JavaScript strings. JavaScript strings are candidates requiring runtime review.
Resolve local paths relative to their source. Map the former asset host uploads to assets/media, theme/plugin files to assets/vendor, and core files to assets/vendor/wp-includes.
Match external URLs using the existing assets/external/<host>/<sha256(url)[0:16]><extension> scheme; existing matches were checked against the tree.
Count unique destination paths, not URL query variants or repeated page references. All 127 scanned source files are reachable from the 30 HTML entry pages under the proposed local asset mapping.
Source references prove that an asset is referenced, not that it is visible at every viewport. Do not delete files based on this scan.
limitations: This is a static inventory of currently available source. Missing remote CSS and JavaScript may introduce additional fonts, icons, chunks or images; resolve those dependencies when the required files are obtained.
The four referenced video files have not been downloaded or measured.
Runtime asset base URLs remain in scripts; static reference rewriting alone does not prove independent operation.
External map embeds are service dependencies, not transferable site files.
No browser, network availability, licence, build or email delivery verification was performed in this inventory step.
